# Bases

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A core plugin that creates custom views to edit, sort, and filter files using properties.

## Scope note

- Used for frequent or common views of notes with properties.
- Helpful for metadata management of properties.
- Enables CSV export of notes and properties.

## Broader

- [Obsidian Plugin](../ObsidianPlugin/)
